newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 pct - traders.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 pct - traders.

text.p: The Bank of Canada conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money markets on Wednesday at 3.25 percent, dealers said.
The central bank intervened on the money market after the call loan or overnight lending rate rose to the top of the bank's 2.75-3.25 percent target range.
"We were paying 3.25 percent so the market was bid there at the time the Bank of Canada came in doing specials," said a trader at one bank-owned brokerage.
The call loan rate remained bid at 3.25 percent in the wake of the intervention. The yield on the three-month cash T-bill had fallen to 2.86 percent from 2.88 percent at Tuesday's close.
